questions.question: Integrate by parts: ∫ x × e^x dx
questions.solution:
Step 1: Use ∫u dv = uv - ∫v du
Step 2: u = x, dv = e^x dx
Step 3: du = dx, v = e^x
Step 4: ∫x·e^x dx = x·e^x - ∫e^x dx
Answer: x·e^x - e^x + C = e^x(x-1) + C

questions.question: Find: ∫ sin(5x) dx
questions.solution:
Step 1: ∫sin(kx) dx = -cos(kx)/k + C
Step 2: ∫sin(5x) dx = -cos(5x)/5 + C
Answer: -cos(5x)/5 + C

questions.question: Evaluate: ∫ x^2 dx
questions.solution:
Step 1: Use power rule ∫x^n dx = x^(n+1)/(n+1) + C
Step 2: ∫x^2 dx = x^3/3 + C
Answer: x^3/3 + C
